name: Access checked on every short history
what: The part of the core that decides access is written first, in Zig: who holds what, and the calls that touch it. A test tries every sequence of these calls, up to a size, among a few computers, secrets and hosts, and checks that nothing is granted except by you or by a rule you set.

suggest.why: `model-of-access-first`, taken, already commits to building exactly this test.
